request.prompt:
Exact SAME blue crystal golem from both references: same pointed crystalline head/eyes, massive faceted shoulders, long bulky crystal fists, V chest, stout jointed legs/flat feet, cobalt/sapphire and icy-white facets, same detailed painted2D RPG model and isometric camera. Solid blue joint connections keep head, torso, arms, hands, hips and feet attached. No different robot, clothes, weapon, hair or tail. CONSTANT character proportions/physical scale. Alpha ZERO off the complete figures, no particles/debris/fog/floor/shadow, no cropped spikes/fists/toes or neighboring-pose contamination. Broad transparent gutters. Real joint movement, no global rotate/scale/mirror copies.
Exactly SIX separate complete figures in THREE COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, spacious landscape sheet. Top row faces EAST/right profile; bottom row faces SE/front-right. Columns are ANTICIPATION, CONTACT, RECOVERY. Column1 connected right elbow/fist winds back with hips/knees grounded and opposite arm balancing. Column2 the connected right shoulder/elbow/wrist drives the large crystal fist forward to contact, whole-body weight on the front supporting foot. Column3 elbow retracts and hips/knees settle back toward idle. NO detached fist/upper arm or magic/sword. All6 figures have the same model/physical scale. Make each figure SMALL ENOUGH within its spacious cell to leave generous transparent padding around the maximum forward fist extent; no bounding rectangle may contain any neighboring figure. Keep at least substantial clear gaps horizontally and vertically. Do not create an opaque blue background; actual transparent alpha off each body. Only6 figures, not a poster.
